title: Full-time NSFs Declaring Psychological or Mental Health Conditions Prior to Enlistment and Support Provided
what_it_is: Full-time NSFs Declaring Psychological or Mental Health Conditions Prior to Enlistment and Support Provided

sections.label: Mental health rates among pre-enlistees and NSFs
sections.summary: In 2024, 9% of pre-enlistees had mental health issues and 11% of full-time NSFs sought help, with a general upward trend over time.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Defence (Mr Desmond Choo) (for the Coordinating Minister for Public Services and Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: The proportion of pre-enlistees detected to have mental health issues was 9% in 2024.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Defence (Mr Desmond Choo) (for the Coordinating Minister for Public Services and Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: For our Full-time NSF, 11% sought help for some form of mental health-related issues in 2024.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Defence (Mr Desmond Choo) (for the Coordinating Minister for Public Services and Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: While the figures vary year to year, there has been a general upward trend over time, similar to our national youth mental health trend.

sections.label: Mental health screening and NS deferment
sections.summary: Pre-enlistee medical exams include mental health screening, with in-house psychiatrist review and deferment from NS if assessed as posing harm.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Choo
sentences.text: Today, the medical examination of pre-enlistees already includes screening for mental health conditions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Choo
sentences.text: Those with mental health conditions will be reviewed by our in-house psychiatrists.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Choo
sentences.text: If it is assessed that they may pose harm to themselves or others, they will be deferred from NS until their conditions have improved and they pose no other risk to themselves or to their fellow NSFs.

sections.label: Support and monitoring for NSFs
sections.summary: NSFs with mental health issues who can serve receive additional monitoring, and the SAF has a mental health support system.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Choo
sentences.text: NSFs with mental health issues who are able to serve will receive additional monitoring while in service.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Choo
sentences.text: The SAF has a mental health support system in place to detect and support service personnel with mental health issues.
